scheme_name: Internship Scheme Of Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO)
other_conditions: Pursuing law in the last two years of degree course or a law graduate
Pursuing post‑graduation in law or a research scholar in law
Pursuing post‑graduation courses such as MBA, MSW, MSc, MA, M.Com., or MCA
Enrolled in a recognized university/institution within India or abroad
Internship duration of a minimum of 2 months and a maximum of 6 months
Maximum of 10 interns may be engaged
benefits_summary: Selected interns receive a stipend of ₹8,000 per month, logistic support including workspace and computer with internet, and a certificate upon satisfactory completion.
